## PR244 F3 closure review

**Verdict: NEEDS_FIX**

This is a static review of the supplied text. I did not run tests, verify hashes, or open `mcp.json`. The logs are host-recorded evidence, and I did not re-execute them.

## Round 4 blockers

| Item | Status | Basis |
|---|---|---|
| B1: throwing `invoke()` after child launch | Closed | `invocationAttempted` is set before `adapter.invoke`. A throw then yields `verify.adapter_stop_unconfirmed`, and `runVerifierAdapters` breaks on it. The owned-child test covers this. |
| B2: selection-time probes of verifier-role adapters | Closed for execution selection | `selectExecutionAgent` removes `verifierAgentIds` before routing and policy candidates. The new test checks that the probe and `invoke` are not called. The reviewer probe now runs only inside `invokeVerifierAdapter`, after `beforeSnapshot`. |
| B3: invariant wording | Closed by owner wording | The audit report limits the claim to observed mutation in the candidate workspace. It also records the `git status` and `add -A` clean-filter residual. Two omitted items are listed below. |
| Sparse checkout and global/system config | Tests match the choice | Sparse refusal tests exist in `review-boundary.test.ts` and `candidate-policy.test.ts`. The global/system exclude test is a valid negative. |
| Silent drop of hidden builder edits | Closed for hidden entries | `assertCandidateIndexVisible` runs before worktree publication. The regression uses a generic reviewer. A no-diff success remains a legitimate no-op. |
| Final-stage reviewer mutation | Closed | The new test mutates on verifier call 2 (prepush) and call 3 (final) in the main workspace. It checks the final-preflight failure, unchanged HEAD, retained containment, and zero restart executions. |
| Scratch key | Closed | `createScratchDirSync` uses `mkdtemp`, which adds a random suffix. The PID is only a label. The Vitest config is attached. |
| Deadline test (`toBe(20)`) | Accepted | It passes in the host log. It depends on fake `performance.now()`. |
| Snapshot cost | Measured for one repository | The no-op invocation and ignored count are recorded. Submodule and tree caps are still absent (see residuals). |

I did not find a new path where a mutating reviewer can approve or commit its own edit, within the stated boundary.

## New defects

**1. Pre-effect role refusals retain the lifecycle lease.**
`runCycle` sets `lifecycleEffectsStarted = true` before `runTask`. `selectExecutionAgent` now throws `VERIFIER_EXECUTION_ROLE_CONFLICT` and `NO_EXECUTION_ADAPTER_OUTSIDE_VERIFIER_ROLE` inside `runTask`. `withLifecycleLease` then retains the lease when `!settled && lifecycleEffectsStarted`. A configuration mistake therefore keeps the lease under the label "execution or external stop unconfirmed."
- Fix: validate role configuration before the flag is set, or set the flag after selection and before `createWorktree`.
- Test: inject a lifecycle lease, trigger each refusal, and expect `release()`.

**2. The index check conflates infrastructure errors with hidden entries, and it has a new size limit.**
`freezeCandidate` now calls `assertCandidateIndexVisible`. That runs `ls-files -v -z` through `gitRaw`, which has `maxBuffer: 1_048_576`. Before this change, freeze used only `status`, whose output is small. The output of `ls-files` grows with the tracked index. At roughly 20,000 tracked paths, the call fails. The engine's `catch` then sets `candidateContaminated = true` for any error. This makes a size limit or a Git timeout look like contamination and retains containment.
- Fix: raise the buffer or stream the output. Match only `CANDIDATE_HIDDEN_INDEX_ENTRY` as contamination. Report other errors as ordinary failures, or document why they also fail closed.
- Test: a large tracked index must succeed, or the cap must be documented.

**3. Two behavior changes need owner confirmation, and one branch is now unreachable.**
- An `agentId` override that is also a verifier now always throws. It previously ran unless `enforceRoleSeparation` was set.
- A routing miss with some verifier-only adapters now throws `NO_EXECUTION_ADAPTER_OUTSIDE_VERIFIER_ROLE`. It previously returned `local-noop`. The message names the wrong cause.
- The `enforceRoleSeparation` block in `runTask` appears unreachable for configured verifier IDs. Remove it, or test it.

## Needs context

- **Test environment scope.** `scripts/vitest-setup-scratch.ts` is wired only in `packages/loop/vitest.config.ts`. The report says all tests set `OSSTACK_LOOP_CONTAINMENT_ROOT`. Confirm that every package whose tests can reach `LoopEngine` (CLI, daemon, scheduler) uses this setup. Otherwise those tests can write to the real `~/.osstack/loop-containment`.
- **Full loop-package run.** The B2 log runs only `loop-engine.test.ts`. The engine source changed. Budget, waiting-reason, feedback, policy-gate, candidate-execution, and worktree-preservation tests need a full package run on the final tree. Global QA remains separate.

## Accepted limits

- Snapshots observe only the candidate worktree and selected Git metadata. They do not cover other working trees.
- The clean-filter residual applies to `git status`, `add -A`, and `diff`. Disabling ext-diff, textconv, and fsmonitor does not disable all filters.
- A probe that throws or times out is always `stop-unconfirmed`. This is conservative and accepted.
- Non-verifier adapters can run availability probes during selection, outside any snapshot. Their writes become builder-side candidate content. This is not verifier self-approval.
- The post-invocation snapshot runs inside the same deadline. An exhausted budget requires manual reconciliation.

## Not yet in the audit report

- `.git/objects`, reflogs (`logs/`), `info/sparse-checkout`, and files pulled in by `[include]` are not hashed.
- Each Git subprocess output is capped at 64 MiB. Raw tracked and untracked byte streams have no aggregate cap. The deadline is the only gate. There is no large-tree test.
- Legacy worktree publication now refuses sparse-checkout repositories. This goes beyond the candidate-freeze and review-boundary refusal the owner decided.
- A reviewer that runs `git status` without `GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS=0` can rewrite `index`. That causes a `reviewer_mutation` false positive. The failure is closed, but real adapters need qualification.

## Minimum to re-review

1. Fix the lease classification (item 1), with a lease-release test.
2. Fix the index-check buffer and error classification (item 2), with a large-index test or a documented cap.
3. Confirm or revert the role-conflict behavior changes, and remove or test the dead branch (item 3).
4. Confirm the Vitest containment-root wiring for every package that reaches `LoopEngine`.
5. Run the full loop package on the final tree.
6. Add the omitted residuals to the audit report.
